prompt:
You are one of 3 agents on a team led by an orchestrator. You do ONLY your assigned subtask.
The orchestrator will see your output beside the other two agents' and will assemble the final answer.
Do your part completely and state plainly anything you could not settle, so the orchestrator can.

YOUR SUBTASK (3 of 3): Evidence item with PropertyValue nodes
Write ONLY the delphi:EvidenceItem node and its schema:PropertyValue nodes, to sit inside graph sub:assertion of a TriG nanopub (no prefixes, no graph wrapper, no claim node). Subject <https://w3id.org/delphi/resource/evidence/composite-never-beat-its-strongest-term> a delphi:EvidenceItem ; rdfs:label ; dct:description (name locator sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md with line numbers :14, :33, :35, :36, :38, :43, :13 in the text; say numbers come from the blind held-out run, 168 held-out families scored family-out, v1.3.0) ; schema:additionalProperty linking to one schema:PropertyValue node per reported number, each with schema:propertyID, schema:value (typed xsd:decimal or string), schema:description naming its locator. Use blank nodes or sub: IRIs (e.g. sub:pv-p1-rank-score). Nodes: P1 rank_score 0.875 (:33); diff vs nearest-neighbour +0.032 (:33); its CI low 0.026 and high 0.040 (:33); diff vs joint Mahalanobis alone on P1 -0.008 (:35) with CI -0.020 to 0.002 (:35); all-items diff -0.007 (:36) with CI -0.013 to -0.002 (:36); joint term alone P1 0.883 (:38); held-out families 168 (:14). You may keep a CI as one node with string value like "-0.020 to 0.002". Only numeric literals allowed: 168, 0.875, 0.032, 0.026, 0.040, 0.008, 0.020, 0.002, 0.007, 0.013, 0.883, 1.3.0, 4, 5. No other numbers. Output Turtle fragment only, no commentary.

TASK: write ONE unsigned nanopublication draft (TriG) recording the finding below.

THE FINDING IN ONE LINE
The design scorer's composite has never beaten its own strongest single term on the primary ranking endpoint.

THE DOSSIER. These are the only facts you have. Each carries its LOCATOR, which is how a reader finds it again.
  [1] locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:14
      fact: Every number is from the blind held-out run of each scorer version: 168 held-out families, scored family-out.
  [2] locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:33
      fact: v1.3.0 rank_score beats nearest-neighbour distance on endpoint P1: 0.875, difference +0.032, CI 0.026 to 0.040.
  [3] locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:35
      fact: rank_score does NOT beat its own joint Mahalanobis term used alone on P1: difference -0.008, CI -0.020 to 0.002.
  [4] locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:36
      fact: Over all held-out items the composite is significantly WORSE than the joint term alone: -0.007, CI -0.013 to -0.002.
  [5] locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:38
      fact: The joint Mahalanobis term used alone reaches P1 0.883 and passes all three primary endpoints by itself.
  [6] locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:43
      fact: The other components earn their place only on secondary endpoints S4 and S5, which the joint term alone fails.
  [7] locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:13
      fact: The evaluation was run by an evaluator who built neither the scorer nor the benchmark; dev results count for nothing.

The only numeric literals you may write are these: 168, 0.875, 0.032, 0.026, 0.040, 0.008, 0.020, 0.002, 0.007, 0.013, 0.883, 1.3.0, 4, 5. Any other number is an invention.

REQUIRED SHAPE. Use exactly these prefixes, verbatim:
@prefix this: <http://purl.org/nanopub/temp/np1/> .
@prefix sub: <http://purl.org/nanopub/temp/np1/> .
@prefix np: <http://www.nanopub.org/nschema#> .
@prefix npx: <http://purl.org/nanopub/x/> .
@prefix nt: <https://w3id.org/np/o/ntemplate/> .
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/> .
@prefix prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> .
@prefix schema: <https://schema.org/> .
@prefix spdx: <http://spdx.org/rdf/terms#> .
@prefix delphi: <https://w3id.org/delphi/ontology/> .

Then four named graphs: sub:Head (this: a np:Nanopublication with np:hasAssertion sub:assertion,
np:hasProvenance sub:provenance, np:hasPublicationInfo sub:pubinfo), sub:assertion, sub:provenance, sub:pubinfo.
In sub:assertion put a delphi:Claim at
  <https://w3id.org/delphi/resource/claim/composite-never-beat-its-strongest-term>
with rdfs:label (one quotable sentence), dct:description, delphi:hasEvidence pointing at a delphi:EvidenceItem at
  <https://w3id.org/delphi/resource/evidence/composite-never-beat-its-strongest-term>
which itself carries rdfs:label, dct:description and one schema:additionalProperty / schema:PropertyValue node
per number you report (schema:propertyID, schema:value, schema:description).
In sub:provenance: sub:assertion prov:wasAttributedTo an agent IRI and prov:wasDerivedFrom the locators.
In sub:pubinfo: dct:created (an xsd:dateTime), dct:creator, an rdfs:label beginning "Draft: ",
dct:license <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/>, npx:hasNanopubType delphi:Claim,
npx:introduces the claim IRI, delphi:domain <https://w3id.org/delphi/resource/domain/design-scorer-evaluation>
with an rdfs:label for that domain node, and an rdfs:comment saying it is an unsigned draft, not published.

HONESTY RULES, which are what this record is for:
- Every literal longer than a line must be traceable: name the locator it came from, in the literal or via prov:wasDerivedFrom.
- Write no number that is not in the allowed list above.
- The claim's dct:description must state the finding's STATUS in words and must state what the finding does NOT establish.
- Do not reuse a description, label or comment you would write for a different finding. Shared boilerplate is the failure mode being measured.
- The record is UNSIGNED. Say so in the pubinfo rdfs:comment.

Output the TriG as the `trig` field and the locators you cited as `cited_locators`. No commentary.

<https://w3id.org/delphi/resource/evidence/composite-never-beat-its-strongest-term> a delphi:EvidenceItem ;
    rdfs:label "Held-out comparison of the v1.3.0 rank_score composite against nearest-neighbour distance and against its joint Mahalanobis term alone" ;
    dct:description "Numbers are transcribed from sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md, at lines :14 (run scope: 168 held-out families, scored family-out), :33 (rank_score vs nearest-neighbour on P1), :35 (rank_score vs joint term alone on P1), :36 (all held-out items), :38 (joint term alone on P1), :43 (other components help only on secondary endpoints S4 and S5) and :13 (evaluator built neither scorer nor benchmark). All figures come from the blind held-out run of v1.3.0, 168 held-out families scored family-out; development results are not counted." ;
    schema:additionalProperty
        sub:pv-heldout-families ,
        sub:pv-p1-rank-score ,
        sub:pv-diff-vs-nn ,
        sub:pv-diff-vs-nn-ci-low ,
        sub:pv-diff-vs-nn-ci-high ,
        sub:pv-diff-vs-joint-p1 ,
        sub:pv-diff-vs-joint-p1-ci ,
        sub:pv-diff-all-items ,
        sub:pv-diff-all-items-ci ,
        sub:pv-joint-alone-p1 .

sub:pv-heldout-families a schema:PropertyValue ;
    schema:propertyID "heldout_family_count" ;
    schema:value "168"^^xsd:decimal ;
    schema:description "Number of held-out families in the blind run, scored family-out. Locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:14" .

sub:pv-p1-rank-score a schema:PropertyValue ;
    schema:propertyID "p1_rank_score_v1.3.0" ;
    schema:value "0.875"^^xsd:decimal ;
    schema:description "v1.3.0 rank_score on endpoint P1. Locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:33" .

sub:pv-diff-vs-nn a schema:PropertyValue ;
    schema:propertyID "p1_diff_rank_score_minus_nearest_neighbour" ;
    schema:value "0.032"^^xsd:decimal ;
    schema:description "Difference on P1, rank_score minus nearest-neighbour distance (positive: composite ahead). Locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:33" .

sub:pv-diff-vs-nn-ci-low a schema:PropertyValue ;
    schema:propertyID "p1_diff_vs_nearest_neighbour_ci_low" ;
    schema:value "0.026"^^xsd:decimal ;
    schema:description "Lower confidence bound of the difference versus nearest-neighbour on P1. Locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:33" .

sub:pv-diff-vs-nn-ci-high a schema:PropertyValue ;
    schema:propertyID "p1_diff_vs_nearest_neighbour_ci_high" ;
    schema:value "0.040"^^xsd:decimal ;
    schema:description "Upper confidence bound of the difference versus nearest-neighbour on P1. Locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:33" .

sub:pv-diff-vs-joint-p1 a schema:PropertyValue ;
    schema:propertyID "p1_diff_rank_score_minus_joint_mahalanobis_alone" ;
    schema:value "-0.008"^^xsd:decimal ;
    schema:description "Difference on P1, rank_score minus its joint Mahalanobis term used alone (negative: composite behind, not distinguishable from zero). Locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:35" .

sub:pv-diff-vs-joint-p1-ci a schema:PropertyValue ;
    schema:propertyID "p1_diff_vs_joint_term_ci" ;
    schema:value "-0.020 to 0.002" ;
    schema:description "Confidence interval of the P1 difference versus the joint term alone; it spans zero. Locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:35" .

sub:pv-diff-all-items a schema:PropertyValue ;
    schema:propertyID "all_items_diff_rank_score_minus_joint_term" ;
    schema:value "-0.007"^^xsd:decimal ;
    schema:description "Difference over all held-out items, rank_score minus joint term alone (composite significantly worse). Locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:36" .

sub:pv-diff-all-items-ci a schema:PropertyValue ;
    schema:propertyID "all_items_diff_ci" ;
    schema:value "-0.013 to -0.002" ;
    schema:description "Confidence interval of the all-items difference; it excludes zero. Locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:36" .

sub:pv-joint-alone-p1 a schema:PropertyValue ;
    schema:propertyID "p1_joint_mahalanobis_term_alone" ;
    schema:value "0.883"^^xsd:decimal ;
    schema:description "P1 reached by the joint Mahalanobis term used alone. Locator: sim-engine/validate/evaluation/SCORER-EVALUATION.md:38" .
